metaTitle: Custom Direct to Garment Workwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment workwear for your team. Soft, breathable prints with no minimums. Get a quote from Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Direct to garment printing gives your workwear a soft, breathable feel that won't crack or peel after repeated washes. Unlike heat transfer or embroidery, DTG allows for full-color, photographic-quality designs on cotton and cotton-blend fabrics. This makes it ideal for marketing teams who want detailed logos or safety managers needing high-visibility accents with no bulky layers. Bulk orders maintain consistent color across every piece.
heroAltText: Custom direct to garment workwear with full-color logo print on a soft cotton polo shirt
